name: Tetromino shaft
description: A flight down a square shaft whose four walls are tiled with beveled tetrominoes. Near blocks fill the corners, far ones converge on the vanishing point, and whole rows flash out on the bar.

cell.description: Blocks across each wall of the shaft. Low is chunky and close, high is a fine mesh.

fall.description: How fast the shaft flies past. Negative reads as falling into it.

gaps.description: Fraction of pieces left out, so the wall has holes in it instead of being solid.

drift.description: How far the shaft axis wanders off the middle of the frame.
